policy: Factual names and conditions from the linked catalogue. Original interface and explanatory text. Game artwork is served locally with public source URLs and checksums in docs/media-sources.json; rights remain with their respective owners. Missing images are labeled. No competitor application code is included. Upstream verified labels are not independent in-game verification. Warzone conditions carrying unverified notes remain community-reported. Class thresholds are not inferred from inventory size.
